content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, Thank you for sending over the agreement. Before I sign, I would like to propose a few minor adjustments to ensure everything is balanced. Here is the point I would like to discuss: - Regarding the clause "9.1.1 The Liability Cap will not apply to any (1) material confidentiality breach under Section 5, and/or (2) indemnification obligations under Section 7.1.", your liability is capped overall, but your indemnification obligations and confidentiality breaches are excluded from that cap, exposing you to potentially unlimited damages in those areas. I propose changing this to: "The Liability Cap shall apply to all claims and liabilities arising under or related to this Agreement, including indemnification obligations." Please let me know if these adjustments work for you so we can move forward. Best regards,
